quests.summary: Collect 3 glacier roses from the snowy cliffs and the Cloud Caves; Granny Xue teaches you Snowball Volley.

objectives.note: A map-maker who is, embarrassingly, lost: 我迷路了!
Read the signpost (on the way from npc_1 to town): 往左走 / 往右走 / 一直走 (choice).
He gives you a map with a ? on it (marks the Cloud Caves door).

quests.summary: Guide the lost map-maker back to Cloud Ridge by reading the cliff signposts.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: The wind stops howling. The great blue dragon lands on the cliff edge... and bows its head.

lines.speaker: wind_dragon
lines.en: Sorry. The fog was inside my head. I didn't know what I was doing.
lines.zh: 对不起。我不知道我在做什么。
lines.zhTrad: 對不起。我不知道我在做什麼。

lines.speaker: wind_dragon
lines.en: Wait... that little golden one. Come closer, small one. Let me see your scales.

lines.speaker: wind_dragon
lines.en: Your mother is my friend. Golden scales, just like yours. I'd know them anywhere.

lines.speaker: wind_dragon
lines.en: She is very far away. The Demon King's fog took her, and they bound her with a chain of shadow.

lines.speaker: wind_dragon
lines.en: She hid her last egg in a quiet village, so the fog would never find it. I tried to stop them. Then the fog found me too.

lines.speaker: wind_dragon
lines.en: Far. Very far. But you have many friends now.

lines.speaker: wind_dragon
lines.en: Go north. Keep going straight: past the Griffin Peaks, past the Ogre Colosseum, all the way to the Demon King's castle.

lines.speaker: wind_dragon
lines.en: Brave, like her. When you reach her, call my name into the wind and I will come.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Xiaolong stares north for a long time. Then he eats three snacks, very bravely.
